heading: String ordering in cross-pattern position
text:
### String ordering in cross-pattern position [LNLS.3.8]

A `where` clause that compares String-typed slot values from different
patterns using `<`, `>`, `<=`, or `>=` is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_STRING_ORDER`).

String ordering uses `strncmp` — O(min(a.len, b.len)).  In a
single-pattern where clause (alpha test), this cost is bounded and
allowed even in `linear_scan: false` if the slot carries a `capacity`.
In cross-pattern position it would become a join test
that also prevents lmem_idx construction (violating LNLS.3.3).
